name: Tyrone Marhguy
tagline: Discrete transistors to tapeout — and the software that ships with them.
bio: Computer Engineering Junior at Penn specializing in physical hardware implementation and verification — RTL through Sky130 ASIC flow, open-source EDA contributions (Verilator, LibreLane, OpenROAD, OpenFPGA), and builds from a 32-bit CPU and 3,488-MOSFET ALU to a 22nm SRAM macro.
hardwareTrack: RTL, FPGA, and ASIC tapeouts — discrete logic through silicon.
softwareTrack: Production backends, embedded firmware, and tooling.
